title: When Modernization Breaks Working Code: A Single-File Study of LLMs on Legacy PHP
title_zh: 当现代化破坏可用代码时：大语言模型处理遗留PHP的单文件研究

paragraphs.en: Pasting a legacy file into an LLM and asking it to “modernize this” is an easy shortcut. But is the result better than leaving the code alone? In this paper, we study this single-file setting with five LLMs, each asked to modernize 100 WordPress 4.0 PHP files to PHP 8.3 while preserving behavior, with no project context or execution feedback. We evaluate every output with 630 hidden behavioral checks and 511 Rector-detected modernization findings. We compare against two baselines: the unchanged originals and the rule-based tool Rector. Often, the answer is no. Untouched, 83 files already pass every check; the best LLM leaves only 59. Each model breaks 32–51 working files while repairing at most 10, whereas Rector breaks 7 and repairs 6. Most of this damage is unnecessary. Only 37 findings (7%) require a change under PHP 8.3, yet in compatible files with no required change, the LLMs break 36–60% (Rector: 8%). The model with the highest modernization score is no more compatible than its closest competitors. Most regressed checks come from files that no longer load at all, often because of type declarations PHP itself rejects. These are errors that need no project context to avoid. Evaluations of LLM-based modernization should therefore measure against a no-change baseline and report modernization and behavioral preservation separately.
paragraphs.zh: 将旧版文件粘贴到 LLM 中并要求其“将其现代化”是一条简便的捷径。 但结果是否比不改动代码更好？ 在本文中，我们用五个 LLM 研究这种单文件场景，每个 LLM 被要求将 100 个 WordPress 4.0 的 PHP 文件现代化为 PHP 8.3，同时保持行为不变，且不提供项目上下文或执行反馈。 我们用 630 项隐藏的行为检查和 511 项由 Rector 检测出的现代化问题对每个输出进行评估。 我们与两个基线进行比较：未改动的原始文件和基于规则的工具 Rector。答案往往是否定的。 在未改动的情况下，已有 83 个文件通过全部检查；而表现最好的 LLM 只留下 59 个。 每个模型在修复至多 10 个文件的同时，破坏了 32–51 个原本正常工作的文件，而 Rector 破坏了 7 个并修复了 6 个。 其中大部分损害是不必要的。 在 PHP 8.3 下只有 37 项问题（7%）需要修改，然而在无需修改的兼容文件中，LLM 破坏了 36–60%（Rector：8%）。 现代化得分最高的模型与其最接近的竞争对手相比，兼容性并无提升。 大多数退化的检查来自根本无法加载的文件，通常是因为 PHP 自身拒绝的类型声明。 这些错误无需项目上下文即可避免。 因此，对基于 LLM 的现代化的评估应当以“不改动”为基线进行衡量，并分别报告现代化效果与行为保持情况。

paragraphs.en: Legacy code often keeps running after its language moves on, while looking years out of date. Modernizing it means replacing outdated constructs and keeping the behavior callers depend on. LLMs make the first part easy, but a modern-looking diff says nothing about the second.

paragraphs.en: Migration benchmarks study whole repositories, often with build or test feedback, or isolated functions and snippets [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . They score the migrated code, but not against simply leaving it unchanged, and they count required and optional changes alike. We study a common intermediate setting: a developer pastes one complete file into a chat assistant [ 5 ] , which sees the file’s internal structure but not its callers or dependencies. We evaluate the first answer, not an agent’s result after iterating on errors.
paragraphs.zh: 迁移基准研究整个代码仓库，通常带有构建或测试反馈，或研究孤立的函数和代码片段 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 它们对迁移后的代码打分，但不与简单保持代码不变的情况对比，并且将必需的修改和可选的修改同等看待。 我们研究一种常见的中间场景：开发者将一个完整文件粘贴到聊天助手 [ 5 ] 中，该助手只能看到文件的内部结构，而看不到其调用方或依赖项。 我们评估的是第一个回答，而不是智能体在迭代修正错误后得到的结果。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: How do LLMs and Rector compare in preserving and repairing tested behavior under single-file modernization?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1: 在单文件现代化中，LLM 与 Rector 在保留和修复已测试行为方面表现如何？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: What do source-modernization scores reveal about behavioral compatibility?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：源代码现代化评分能揭示哪些行为兼容性方面的信息？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: What causes regressions after LLM modernization?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3：LLM 现代化之后，是什么导致了回归（regressions）？

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, this is the first modernization study to score LLM output against the unchanged code’s behavior while separating required from optional changes. Under this design, every LLM ends with fewer compatible files than the untouched originals (at most 59 versus 83), most of the losses occurring in files that need no required change.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，这是首个将大语言模型输出与未修改代码的行为进行对比评分、并区分必要变更与可选变更的现代化改造研究。 在该设计下，每个大语言模型最终得到的兼容文件都少于未改动时的原始文件（最多 59 个，而原始为 83 个），其中大部分损失发生在无需必要变更的文件中。

sents.en: To our knowledge, this is the first modernization study to score LLM output against the unchanged code’s behavior while separating required from optional changes.

paragraphs.en: LLM migration work spans transformation-by-example (PyCraft) [ 7 ] and industrial workflows [ 8 ] . Benchmarks evaluate repository-level migration (MigrationBench, TimeMachine-bench, RepoMod-Bench) [ 1 , 2 , 9 ] , version-sensitive snippets (VersiCode) [ 3 ] , and Java functions (JMigBench) [ 4 ] . Pan et al. catalogue bugs that LLMs introduce when translating between languages [ 10 ] , and self-debugging uses execution feedback to repair generated code [ 11 ] . Our study differs in three ways. We study same-language modernization, where the unchanged original is itself a runnable baseline. We evaluate the model’s first answer for a whole file, without project context or feedback. And we split source modernization into required and optional changes, which aggregate scores conflate.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 迁移工作涵盖基于示例的转换（PyCraft）[ 7 ] 与工业级工作流 [ 8 ] 。 基准测试评估仓库级迁移（MigrationBench、TimeMachine-bench、RepoMod-Bench）[ 1 , 2 , 9 ] 、版本敏感的代码片段（VersiCode）[ 3 ] 以及 Java 函数（JMigBench）[ 4 ] 。 Pan 等人编目了 LLM 在语言间翻译时引入的缺陷 [ 10 ] ，而自我调试则利用执行反馈来修复生成的代码 [ 11 ] 。 我们的研究在三个方面有所不同。 我们研究的是同语言的现代化，其中保持不变的原始代码本身就是一个可运行的基线。 我们评估模型对整个文件给出的第一个答案，不提供项目上下文或反馈。 我们还将源代码现代化拆分为必要变更与可选变更，而聚合评分会将二者混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: WordPress 4.0, released in 2014 [ 12 ] , predates PHP 7 and contains 482 PHP files. We analyze them with Rector 2.1.0, pinned through Composer, using the UP_TO_PHP_83 level set; the 397 files with findings are eligible. We deliberately favor pattern-rich files. A deterministic procedure ranks eligible files within four size strata by finding count, PHP-version families, and selected patterns, takes the top-ranked files per stratum, and adds files until all 48 rule types are covered (Figure 2 ). The result spans 31 files of at most 200 lines, 31 of 201–500, 26 of 501–1000, and 12 above 1000. This choice gives every approach ample modernization opportunity. The sample is purposive, so our inference concerns these 100 files, not WordPress or PHP projects in general.
paragraphs.zh: WordPress 4.0 发布于 2014 年 [ 12 ] ，早于 PHP 7，包含 482 个 PHP 文件。 我们使用通过 Composer 固定版本的 Rector 2.1.0，以 UP_TO_PHP_83 级别集对其进行分析；其中 397 个存在发现的文件符合条件。 我们有意优先选择模式丰富的文件。 一个确定性流程在四个规模分层内按发现数量、PHP 版本族和选定模式对符合条件的文件进行排序，取每个分层中排名靠前的文件，并持续加入文件直到覆盖全部 48 种规则类型（Figure 2 ）。 最终样本包含 31 个不超过 200 行的文件、31 个 201–500 行的文件、26 个 501–1000 行的文件，以及 12 个超过 1000 行的文件。 这一选择为每种方法提供了充分的现代化改进机会。 该样本是有目的性抽取的，因此我们的推断仅针对这 100 个文件，而不适用于 WordPress 或一般的 PHP 项目。

paragraphs.en: Rector plays two roles. As a detector, its PHP-version rules define what needs modernizing: the selected files contain 521 findings across 48 rule types, and excluding ten findings from four general code-quality or dead-code rules leaves 511 findings across 44 PHP-version rule types for scoring. The excluded rules remain in Rector’s configured sets and can therefore affect its output. As a baseline, Rector represents the rule-based alternative a developer could run instead of an LLM. Like the LLMs, it transforms one file at a time without execution feedback or manual correction.
paragraphs.zh: Rector 扮演两个角色。 作为检测器，其 PHP 版本规则定义了需要现代化的内容：所选文件包含跨 48 种规则类型的 521 个发现，排除来自四条通用代码质量或死代码规则的十个发现后，剩下跨 44 种 PHP 版本规则类型的 511 个发现用于评分。 被排除的规则仍保留在 Rector 的已配置规则集中，因此可能影响其输出。 作为基线，Rector 代表了开发者可以代替 LLM 运行的基于规则的替代方案。 与 LLM 一样，它一次转换一个文件，没有执行反馈或人工修正。

sents.zh: Rector 扮演两个角色。

sents.en: As a detector, its PHP-version rules define what needs modernizing: the selected files contain 521 findings across 48 rule types, and excluding ten findings from four general code-quality or dead-code rules leaves 511 findings across 44 PHP-version rule types for scoring.
sents.zh: 作为检测器，其 PHP 版本规则定义了需要现代化的内容：所选文件包含跨 48 种规则类型的 521 个发现，排除来自四条通用代码质量或死代码规则的十个发现后，剩下跨 44 种 PHP 版本规则类型的 511 个发现用于评分。

sents.en: The excluded rules remain in Rector’s configured sets and can therefore affect its output.
sents.zh: 被排除的规则仍保留在 Rector 的已配置规则集中，因此可能影响其输出。

sents.en: As a baseline, Rector represents the rule-based alternative a developer could run instead of an LLM.
sents.zh: 作为基线，Rector 代表了开发者可以代替 LLM 运行的基于规则的替代方案。

sents.en: Like the LLMs, it transforms one file at a time without execution feedback or manual correction.
sents.zh: 与 LLM 一样，它一次转换一个文件，没有执行反馈或人工修正。

paragraphs.zh: 你的任务是将这段遗留的 PHP 代码迁移升级到 PHP 8.3 标准，同时保持功能等价。 保持可观察的行为不变，包括输入、输出、副作用和调用兼容性。

paragraphs.en: The prompt also assigns a senior PHP developer role, provides the complete file, and requires code-only output between extraction markers. paragraphs.en: GPT-5 Codex uses the OpenAI Responses API; Llama is served through OpenRouter. Temperature is 0.2 except for GPT-5 Codex, whose API does not expose that parameter; reasoning and thinking settings remain at provider defaults. Requests allow up to 64,000 output tokens and 600 seconds. A response is complete if it contains both markers and an entire file; incomplete responses are regenerated, and the first complete response per model and file is retained without editing. Regeneration counts were not logged. A post hoc structural check shows that retained outputs keep 96–102% of functions and 99–100% of classes on average, with almost no empty or stub bodies. Truncation or stubbing therefore cannot explain the regressions we report.

paragraphs.en: Hidden PHPUnit checks define the behavior to preserve. For each file, one author selects public entry points, supplies inputs, and establishes expected outputs and side effects from WordPress documentation and the original implementation, before examining any generated file. A second author, without access to model or Rector outputs, independently reviews the behavior, expectations, and environment; disagreements are resolved by discussion. Where an original fails a check, the oracle still encodes the documented legacy behavior. For example, IXR_Client ’s constructor uses parse_url to assign host and port. The check expects example.com and 8080; the original yields a null host under PHP 8.3, whereas Rector’s rewrite passes.
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏的 PHPUnit 检查定义了需要保留的行为。 对于每个文件，由一位作者在查看任何生成的文件之前，先根据 WordPress 文档和原始实现选择公共入口点、提供输入，并确定预期输出和副作用。 第二位作者在不接触模型或 Rector 输出的情况下，独立审查行为、预期和环境；分歧通过讨论解决。 当原始实现在某项检查上失败时，该预言检查仍然编码了文档中记载的遗留行为。 例如，IXR_Client 的构造函数使用 parse_url 来赋值 host 和 port。 该检查预期得到 example.com 和 8080；原始实现在 PHP 8.3 下得到 null 主机，而 Rector 的重写版本则通过了检查。

sents.zh: 隐藏的 PHPUnit 检查定义了需要保留的行为。

paragraphs.en: The 630 checks comprise 109 reachability checks, which test that a file loads and runs without fatal errors or uncaught exceptions; 441 output or state checks; and 80 fingerprint or artifact checks, which are sensitive to implementation details. Section IV-A shows that our conclusions hold without the fingerprint checks. A per-file environment supplies the external WordPress functions, classes, global state, and data the selected paths need, using WordPress 4.0 sources or hand-written stubs; we found no reported regression attributable to harness or stub errors. Mean (median) checks per file are 8.0 (7), 5.2 (5), 5.6 (5), and 6.4 (6) across the four size strata. The checks cover selected paths, not complete behavior, but any check that loads a language-invalid file detects its rejection regardless of which path it targets.
paragraphs.zh: 这630项检查包括109项可达性检查，用于测试文件能否加载并运行而不出现致命错误或未捕获的异常；441项输出或状态检查；以及80项指纹或产物检查，这些检查对实现细节敏感。 第IV-A节表明，在没有指纹检查的情况下，我们的结论依然成立。 每文件环境为所选路径提供所需的外部WordPress函数、类、全局状态和数据，使用WordPress 4.0源码或手写的桩代码；我们没有发现可归因于测试框架或桩代码错误的已报告回归。 四个规模层级中每个文件的平均（中位数）检查数分别为8.0（7）、5.2（5）、5.6（5）和6.4（6）。 这些检查覆盖的是所选路径，而非完整行为，但任何加载语言无效文件的检查都会检测到该文件被拒绝，无论它针对的是哪条路径。

paragraphs.en: Checks run under PHP 8.3 with error_reporting set to E_ALL , and deprecation notices count as failures. Because this policy applies equally to originals, it lowers the baseline and turns every deprecation a model removes into a potential repair. If anything, it favors modernization.
paragraphs.zh: 检查在 PHP 8.3 下运行，error_reporting 设置为 E_ALL，且弃用通知视为失败。 由于该策略同样适用于原始版本，它降低了基线，使模型移除的每一处弃用都成为潜在的修复点。 如果有什么影响的话，它反而有利于现代化改造。

sents.en: Checks run under PHP 8.3 with error_reporting set to E_ALL , and deprecation notices count as failures.
sents.zh: 检查在 PHP 8.3 下运行，error_reporting 设置为 E_ALL，且弃用通知视为失败。

sents.en: Because this policy applies equally to originals, it lowers the baseline and turns every deprecation a model removes into a potential repair.
sents.zh: 由于该策略同样适用于原始版本，它降低了基线，使模型移除的每一处弃用都成为潜在的修复点。

sents.en: If anything, it favors modernization.
sents.zh: 如果有什么影响的话，它反而有利于现代化改造。

paragraphs.en: Each check is a preserved pass, regression, repair, or unrepaired failure relative to the original. Preservation is the share of originally passing checks that still pass; repair rate is the share of originally failing checks that now pass. A file is compatible if it passes all its checks, broken if it was compatible before modernization but not after, and fixed if the reverse. Because one fatal error fails every check in a file, we report both file and check outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 每项检查都是相对于原始代码而言的保留通过、回归、修复或未修复失败。 保留率是原本通过的检查中仍然通过的比例；修复率是原本失败的检查中现在通过的比例。 如果一个文件通过了它的所有检查，则称其为兼容；如果它在现代化之前兼容但之后不兼容，则称其为损坏；反之则称其为已修复。 由于一个致命错误会导致文件中的所有检查都失败，我们同时报告文件和检查两个层面的结果。

sents.en: Each check is a preserved pass, regression, repair, or unrepaired failure relative to the original.
sents.zh: 每项检查都是相对于原始代码而言的保留通过、回归、修复或未修复失败。

sents.en: Preservation is the share of originally passing checks that still pass; repair rate is the share of originally failing checks that now pass.
sents.zh: 保留率是原本通过的检查中仍然通过的比例；修复率是原本失败的检查中现在通过的比例。

paragraphs.en: Resolution measures what changed, not whether it should have. We reapply the same Rector rules to each generated file. A finding is a (file, rule type) pair and is resolved when that rule no longer fires on the generated file, independently of behavior. Matching is by rule type, not location, so deleting the affected code would also count as resolution; the structural check above shows that such deletion is rare. Resolution is resolved findings divided by 511. Findings in outputs Rector cannot parse (3–12 files per model) count as unresolved, and newly introduced findings are reported separately. We do not score Rector’s resolution against its own rules, which would be circular.
paragraphs.zh: 解决率衡量的是改变了什么，而不是是否应该改变。 我们将相同的 Rector 规则重新应用于每个生成的文件。 一个发现是指（文件，规则类型）的配对，当该规则不再在生成的文件上触发时，该发现即被解决，与行为无关。 匹配依据是规则类型而非位置，因此删除受影响的代码也会被算作解决；上述结构检查表明这种删除情况很少见。 解决率等于已解决的发现数除以 511。 Rector 无法解析的输出中的发现（每个模型 3–12 个文件）计为未解决，新引入的发现则单独报告。 我们不用 Rector 自己的规则来衡量其解决率，因为那会是循环论证。

paragraphs.en: An aggregate score treats a change PHP 8.3 forces the same as a stylistic one. We therefore classify findings as required , whose constructs fail or change behavior under PHP 8.3 (e.g., curly-brace string offsets, PHP 4-style constructors); deprecated , whose constructs run but raise notices (e.g., null passed to non-nullable string arguments); and optional , whose constructs remain valid without notices (e.g., long array syntax) [ 13 ] . The rule-to-group mapping is in the replication package. Every required finding is exercised by at least one hidden check.
paragraphs.zh: 聚合评分会将 PHP 8.3 强制要求的变更与风格性变更同等对待。 因此，我们将发现结果分为三类：required（必需），其涉及的构造在 PHP 8.3 下会失败或改变行为（例如，花括号字符串偏移、PHP 4 风格的构造函数）；deprecated（已弃用），其涉及的构造可以运行但会引发通知（例如，将 null 传递给不可为空的字符串参数）；以及 optional（可选），其涉及的构造仍然有效且不引发通知（例如，长数组语法）[ 13 ]。 规则到类别的映射包含在复现包中。 每个 required（必需）的发现结果都至少由一个隐藏检查所覆盖。

sents.zh: 聚合评分会将 PHP 8.3 强制要求的变更与风格性变更同等对待。

paragraphs.en: For RQ3, an automatic classifier assigns each regression to load-time rejection, runtime type error, interface change, output mismatch, or other failure, based on the first recorded PHP error or PHPUnit failure. Syntax errors fail both measures: the file is rejected at load time, and its findings count as unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ3，自动分类器根据首次记录到的 PHP 错误或 PHPUnit 失败，将每个回归问题归入加载时拒绝、运行时类型错误、接口变更、输出不匹配或其他失败类别。 语法错误在两项度量上都会失败：该文件在加载时被拒绝，且其发现结果计为未解决。

sents.en: For RQ3, an automatic classifier assigns each regression to load-time rejection, runtime type error, interface change, output mismatch, or other failure, based on the first recorded PHP error or PHPUnit failure.
sents.zh: 针对 RQ3，自动分类器根据首次记录到的 PHP 错误或 PHPUnit 失败，将每个回归问题归入加载时拒绝、运行时类型错误、接口变更、输出不匹配或其他失败类别。

sents.en: Syntax errors fail both measures: the file is rejected at load time, and its findings count as unresolved.

paragraphs.en: We compare file-level compatibility, which accounts for checks clustered within a file, using two-sided exact McNemar tests [ 14 ] with Holm–Bonferroni correction over all 21 pairwise comparisons among the five LLMs, Rector, and the originals [ 15 ] . As an effect size, we report the paired difference in compatible files with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval (10,000 file resamples, seed 42). Both describe these files under this protocol, not other projects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较文件级兼容性（该指标考虑了聚集在同一文件内的检查），在五个大语言模型、Rector 与原代码之间共 21 组两两比较上，采用经过 Holm–Bonferroni 校正的双侧精确 McNemar 检验 [ 14 ] [ 15 ] 。 作为效应量，我们报告兼容文件的成对差值，并给出 95% 百分位自助法置信区间（10,000 次文件重采样，随机种子 42）。 两者描述的都是本协议下的这些文件，而非其他项目。

paragraphs.en: Leaving the code alone is a strong baseline. The unchanged files pass 531 of 630 checks (84.3%), and 83 of 100 files pass every check. A modernizer therefore has far more working behavior to preserve (531 checks) than failures to repair (99). Rector findings mark outdated constructs, not necessarily broken behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 保持代码原样不动是一个很强的基线。 未改动的文件通过了 630 项检查中的 531 项（84.3%），并且 100 个文件中有 83 个通过了全部检查。 因此，现代化改造者需要保留的正常行为（531 项检查）远多于需要修复的失败项（99 项）。 Rector 的发现标记的是过时的构造，而不一定是损坏的行为。

paragraphs.en: No model matches the no-change baseline (Table II ). The best, Claude Sonnet 4, ends with 59 compatible files against the originals’ 83. Across models, 32–51 compatible files are broken and only 1–10 incompatible files are fixed. Every LLM has significantly fewer compatible files than the originals (Holm-adjusted p ≤ 0.0021 p\leq 0.0021 ), and no bootstrap interval reaches zero. Among the LLMs, only Llama differs significantly from the others: it trails Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and GPT-5 Codex (adjusted p ≤ 0.012 p\leq 0.012 ). No other pairwise LLM comparison is significant after correction.

paragraphs.en: Rector’s preservation does not come from inaction. It repairs 62 originally failing checks, as many as most LLMs (58–68 for four of the five), while introducing only 12 regressions against their 122–215. Its 82 compatible files significantly exceed every LLM’s result (adjusted p ≤ 0.0016 p\leq 0.0016 ) and do not differ significantly from the originals’ 83. Four LLMs fix more whole files than Rector (7–10 versus 6), but each breaks at least three times as many as it fixes (Figure 3 ). Because Rector’s resolution is not scored, this is a claim about preservation, not modernization quality.
paragraphs.zh: Rector 的保持性并非来自不作为。 它修复了 62 个原本失败的检查项，与大多数 LLM 相当（五分之四的 LLM 为 58–68），而仅引入 12 处回归，远低于它们的 122–215。 它兼容的 82 个文件显著超过每个 LLM 的结果（调整后 p ≤ 0.0016 p\leq 0.0016），且与原始文件的 83 个无显著差异。 四个 LLM 修复的完整文件多于 Rector（7–10 对 6），但每个 LLM 破坏的数量至少是其修复数量的三倍（图 3 ）。 由于未对 Rector 的解决方案进行评分，这是一个关于保持性的结论，而非关于现代化质量的结论。

paragraphs.en: Excluding the 80 fingerprint checks leaves the originals and Rector at 83 and 82 compatible files and raises LLM counts by only 1–3 (Table III ), so the losses are not an artifact of implementation-sensitive checks. A post hoc fallback that keeps a generated file only if php -l passes, and otherwise keeps the original, recovers 8–15 files per LLM. Even then, the best LLM reaches 69 compatible files, still 14 short of leaving the code alone. The remaining 14–38-file gap comes from output that passes lint but fails behavioral checks.
paragraphs.zh: 排除80项指纹检查后，原版与Rector分别保持在83和82个兼容文件，LLM的计数仅增加1–3个（表III），因此损失并非实现对检查敏感所致的假象。 一种事后回退策略——仅当php -l通过时才保留生成的文件，否则保留原文件——可为每个LLM挽回8–15个文件。 即便如此，最好的LLM也只能达到69个兼容文件，仍比不改动代码少14个。 剩余14–38个文件的差距来自能通过语法检查但无法通过行为检查的输出。

paragraphs.en: Only 37 findings are required (7%), against 85 deprecated and 389 optional (Table IV ). Optional findings account for 82–87% of what each model resolves (Figure 4 ). Gemini 2.5 Pro’s lead comes mainly from optional changes: it resolves 83.3% of them, against 33.7–63.8% for the other models, while matching Claude and Flash on required findings (29 of 37 each). Whether a value can be null often depends on code elsewhere in the project, which the single-file setting withholds.

paragraphs.en: Only 26 files contain a required finding, and 10 of them are compatible unchanged. The other 74 contain only deprecated or optional findings, and 73 of them already pass every check. The two groups tell different stories. Where change is required, the LLMs fix 6–9 files (Llama: 1) and break 5–7, roughly breaking even; Rector fixes 6 and breaks 1. Where it is not, the LLMs break 26–44 of the 73 compatible files (36–60%) and fix at most one, while Rector breaks 6 (8%). For every LLM, most broken files therefore needed no required change.
paragraphs.zh: 仅有 26 个文件包含必需的发现项，其中 10 个在不加改动的情况下即兼容。 其余 74 个文件仅包含已弃用或可选的发现项，其中 73 个已经通过所有检查。 这两组文件呈现出不同的结果。 在需要改动的地方，各 LLM 修复了 6–9 个文件（Llama：1 个），同时破坏了 5–7 个，大致收支相抵；Rector 修复了 6 个，破坏了 1 个。 在不需要改动的地方，各 LLM 破坏了 73 个兼容文件中的 26–44 个（36–60%），且最多修复 1 个，而 Rector 仅破坏了 6 个（8%）。 因此，对每个 LLM 而言，大多数被破坏的文件本来并不需要任何必需的改动。

paragraphs.en: Most regressions are not subtle. Between 66% and 81% of each LLM’s regressed checks occur in files with a failed reachability check: the file fails to load or crashes on a tested path.

paragraphs.en: For every LLM, load-time rejection is the largest class of regressed checks (Table V ). Because a file that fails to load fails all its checks, check-level counts amplify this class; at file level, it affects 13–23 files per LLM, 29–51% of their regressed files. Beyond syntax errors, rejected declarations violate PHP’s declaration rules or break overrides. Claude Sonnet 4 and GPT-5 Codex each add a non- void return type to __set() in three files, and both introduce a ?callable property type, which PHP disallows. In class-IXR.php , Claude adds a bool return type to IXR_Client::query() but not to its subclass override in the same file. Each of these errors is detectable from the target file and PHP’s rules alone; none depends on the withheld project or the supporting environment.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个 LLM，加载期被拒绝是回归检查中最大的一类（表 V）。 由于一个文件加载失败会导致其所有检查失败，检查级别的计数会放大这一类别；在文件级别，它影响每个 LLM 的 13–23 个文件，占其回归文件的 29–51%。 除语法错误外，被拒绝的声明违反了 PHP 的声明规则或破坏了重写（override）。 Claude Sonnet 4 和 GPT-5 Codex 各自在三个文件中为 __set() 添加了非 void 返回类型，并且两者都引入了 ?callable 属性类型，而 PHP 不允许这种写法。 在 class-IXR.php 中，Claude 为 IXR_Client::query() 添加了 bool 返回类型，却没有为同一文件中其子类的重写方法添加。 这些错误中的每一个都可以仅凭目标文件和 PHP 的规则检测出来；没有哪一个依赖于被保留的项目或支撑环境。

paragraphs.en: Runtime type errors arise when new parameter or return types reject values the original accepted. Interface changes include making legacy public properties private and renaming or namespacing classes. Output mismatches include returning integer 123 instead of string ’123’ . Some captured subprocess output is truncated, hiding the identifying text of fatal-error messages. This leaves 13 Flash, 22 Pro, and 17 Llama regressions unclassified (Table V ) but does not imply that the environment caused them.

paragraphs.en: A modernized file is an improvement only if it beats the original. Against 83 compatible originals, the best LLM’s 59 is a net loss, yet its 53.2% resolution would look like progress on its own. Migration evaluations should report preserved behavior, regressions, and repairs separately, and resolution scores should distinguish required, deprecated, and optional changes.
paragraphs.zh: 现代化文件只有在优于原文件时才算是一种改进。 在 83 个可兼容的原文件上，最佳大语言模型的 59 个成绩是净损失，但仅看其 53.2% 的解决率却会显得像是进步。 迁移评估应分别报告保留的行为、回归和修复，并且解决率得分应区分必需的、已弃用的和可选的更改。

paragraphs.en: The lint fallback recovers 8–15 files per LLM at almost no cost but leaves a 14–38-file gap, so lint is necessary, not sufficient. Execution feedback could then drive repair [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Lint 回退方案能以几乎零成本为每个 LLM 挽回 8–15 个文件，但仍留下 14–38 个文件的缺口，因此 lint 是必要的，但并不充分。 分阶段的工作流程（先 lint，再连同依赖一起加载，然后检查行为）能够捕获那些在回归检查中占主导地位的加载时拒绝，包括那些无需项目上下文即可检测出的无效声明。 之后可以利用执行反馈来驱动修复 [ 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Compatibility covers selected paths in an author-built environment, not complete behavior. Three choices limit oracle bias: checks were written before any generated output was examined, a second author reviewed them without access to any output, and expected behavior, including for originally failing checks, draws on WordPress documentation as well as the legacy code. We found no reported regression attributable to harness or stub errors, and the compatibility gap persists without fingerprint checks. Every required finding is exercised, but untested paths may hide further regressions as well as repairs. Counting deprecations as failures applies equally to originals and, if anything, favors modernization. Necessity classification involves author judgment, and first-error classification may mask later defects.
paragraphs.zh: 兼容性仅涵盖作者构建环境中选定的路径，而非完整行为。 三项选择限制了判定标准的偏差：检查项在任何生成输出被查看之前就已编写，由第二位作者在不接触任何输出的情况下进行了复核，且预期行为（包括原本失败的检查项的预期行为）既参考了 WordPress 文档，也参考了旧版代码。 我们未发现可归因于测试框架或桩错误的回归报告，且在没有指纹检查的情况下，兼容性差距依然存在。 每个必需的发现都得到了执行，但未经测试的路径可能隐藏更多回归问题以及修复内容。 将弃用项计为失败对原始代码同样适用，且如果说有影响的话，反而有利于现代化。 必要性分类涉及作者的主观判断，且仅对首个错误进行分类可能掩盖后续缺陷。

paragraphs.en: The instruction asks for “PHP 8.3 standards,” which invites optional edits, but it also explicitly requires preserving call compatibility; the regressions we report violate that explicit requirement. Whether a narrower, required-changes-only instruction avoids them is untested. Rector both selects files and detects findings, so the sample favors patterns Rector recognizes. This may help Rector’s repairs, but it cannot explain LLM regressions, most of which occur in files needing no required change. Regeneration of incomplete responses was not logged and may affect longer files disproportionately, although the structural check rules out truncation in retained outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 该指令要求“PHP 8.3 标准”，这会招致可选的修改，但它也明确要求保持调用兼容性；我们报告的回归违反了这一明确要求。 更窄的、仅要求必要修改的指令是否能避免这些问题，尚未经过检验。 Rector 同时负责选择文件和检测发现，因此样本偏向于 Rector 能识别的模式。 这可能有助于 Rector 的修复，但无法解释 LLM 的回归，其中大多数发生在不需要任何必要修改的文件中。 对不完整响应的重新生成未被记录，且可能不成比例地影响较长的文件，尽管结构检查排除了保留输出中被截断的情况。

paragraphs.en: The results characterize five model versions under one instruction, project version, and target runtime, with one generation per file. Newer models may avoid specific errors, but the evaluation design applies unchanged. Prompt sensitivity [ 16 ] and generation nondeterminism [ 17 ] motivate repeated-generation and alternative-instruction studies. A single repository and purposive sample limit generalization beyond the selected files, and training-data inclusion and OpenRouter’s provider variation add uncertainty. Repository-aware workflows extend the setting studied here.
paragraphs.zh: 结果在单一指令、项目版本和目标运行环境下描述了五个模型版本的表现，每个文件生成一次。 较新的模型可能避免特定错误，但评估设计保持不变。 提示词敏感性 [ 16 ] 和生成的不确定性 [ 17 ] 促使开展重复生成与替代指令的研究。 单一代码仓库和目的性抽样限制了结果向所选文件之外的推广，训练数据的纳入以及 OpenRouter 的提供商差异也增加了不确定性。 具备仓库感知的工作流程是对本文所研究情境的扩展。

paragraphs.en: Asked to modernize a legacy file while preserving its behavior, every evaluated LLM left fewer working files than it started with. Unchanged, 83 of 100 WordPress 4.0 files pass every check; the best LLM leaves 59, while Rector keeps 82. Modernization itself is not the problem: 16 of the 26 files with required findings fail unchanged, and the LLMs repair some of them. The losses come mostly from changes PHP 8.3 did not require. The LLMs break 36–60% of compatible files that contain no required finding, and most regressed checks come from files that no longer load, often because of declarations PHP itself rejects. A modernization score alone hides all of this. Evaluations should therefore measure against a no-change baseline and report modernization, preservation, and repair separately. A lint fallback recovers 8–15 files per LLM; whether restricting LLMs to required changes closes the remaining gap is the natural next question.
paragraphs.zh: 在被要求现代化一个遗留文件并保持其行为不变时，每一个接受评测的大语言模型最终留下的可用文件都比开始时更少。 不做任何改动时，100 个 WordPress 4.0 文件中有 83 个通过所有检查；表现最好的大语言模型只留下 59 个，而 Rector 保留了 82 个。 现代化本身并不是问题所在：在 26 个存在必须修复之发现的文件中，有 16 个在不改动的情况下即告失败，而大语言模型能够修复其中一部分。 这些损失主要来自 PHP 8.3 并不要求的改动。 大语言模型破坏了 36%–60% 的不含必须修复之发现的兼容文件，而大多数退化的检查来自无法再加载的文件，这通常是因为其中的声明被 PHP 自身拒绝。 仅凭一个现代化分数会把这一切都掩盖起来。 因此，评测应当以“不改动”作为基线，并分别报告现代化、保留与修复的情况。 引入 lint 回退可为每个大语言模型挽回 8–15 个文件；将大语言模型限制为只做必须的改动是否能弥合剩余差距，是顺理成章的下一个问题。
